name: Verify filter application and sorting order for search results

steps.name: Given I am on the Amazon Egypt homepage
When I search for a product "productCategory"
And I apply the brand filter "brand_2"
And I apply a price range filter with "targetMinStep" and "targetMaxStep6"
And I sort the results by "priceRange"
Then all displayed products should belong to the brand "brand_2"
And all product prices should be within the selected range
And the search results should be sorted correctly by "priceRange"
